description: editor_status says which editor is connected. open and close save project.godot, which drops a key set on purpose to its default value. close and restart save the open scenes. A restart of an editor this server opened is a quit and then a launch. Ending this server between them, as a reconnect does, leaves no editor. close stops the process of an editor this server opened that has not connected yet. A game a visible editor plays opens a window. Operations: open (needs projectPath): open the editor on a project, answering before it connects; restart: restart the connected editor and wait for it, which puts a gdharness upgrade into effect; close: quit the connected editor and wait for it to go; rebind: end the connected editor's debug sessions and restart its debug adapter in place. Default open.

hidden.description: Open the editor out of sight. Default false on open, and on restart how the editor was started. A hidden editor quits after 10 minutes with no call. The setting gdharness/editor/idle_close_minutes changes that, and 0 turns it off. For ops open, restart.

projectPath.description: Absolute project path. For op open.

silent.description: Open the editor with no sound. Default true on open, and on restart how the editor was started. For ops open, restart.

name: editor_launch
title: Open, restart or close the editor, or bind its debug adapter again
